name: How long does it typically take to install custom trim throughout a room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install custom trim throughout a room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most single-room trim installations, such as updating baseboards or adding crown molding in a bedroom, take one to two days to cut, secure, caulk, and paint. Whole-house baseboard replacements or complex jobs like full-wall board and batten, wainscoting, or coffered ceilings can take three to five days or longer. Timelines expand if your project requires removing stubborn existing trim, leveling uneven framing, or repairing damaged drywall behind baseboards before the new profiles can be fastened securely.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single room usually takes 1 to 2 days for installation and painting, while whole-home trim or intricate wainscoting projects take 3 to 5 days or more.
